result.final_text:
## What this letter says

You had a breast X-ray (mammogram) on 16 September 2026. It was a check called breast screening. Now you need to come back for more tests. This is called a recall. The hospital has booked a visit for you.

Being called back does not mean that you have cancer. About 4 in 5 women who are called back do not have breast cancer.

## What you need to do

1. Go to your visit on Wednesday 7 October 2026 at 11:00. It is at the Breast Assessment Clinic, Eastmoor Hospital.
2. Plan for the visit to take up to 4 hours.
3. You can bring a friend or family member with you.
4. If you cannot come, call 01632 960 733 as soon as you can.

At the visit, you may have more breast X-rays (mammograms). You may have an ultrasound scan. Some people also have a biopsy. This means taking a small sample of tissue. You will usually get most of your results on the same day.

## Dates and medicines

- 16 September 2026: your breast X-ray (mammogram).
- Wednesday 7 October 2026 at 11:00: your recall visit at the Breast Assessment Clinic, Eastmoor Hospital.

The letter does not list any medicines.

## Questions to ask your doctor

- Why do I need more tests?
- What is an ultrasound scan?
- Which tests will I have at my visit?
- When will I get the results I do not get on the day?

## When to get urgent help

The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
